title: llvm build failure

labels.name: category:port-bug
labels.description: The issue is with a library, which is something the port should already support

body:
**Host Environment**
- OS: Windows 10 Pro Version 1909 build 18363.778
- Compiler: MSVC 19.25.28614 for x64

**To Reproduce**
Steps to reproduce the behavior:
`./vcpkg install llvm llvm[clang-tools-extra] llvm[utils] --triplet x64-windows`

**Failure logs** 

